The '''Dark Force Nebula''' was located in a quadrant of the [[Dathomir system/Legends|Dathomir system]]. It was interdicted by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] following the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], after Imperial forces established a base of operations behind the rings of asteroids that surrounded the nebula.
